clips.title: The story
paras: At Deathknell's crypt, Undertaker Mordo greets newly awakened Forsaken. He tells them they are free of the Lich King's control and sends them toward Queen Sylvanas's cause. Bodies that never stir go to the fire.

Undertaker Mordo tends the crypt in Tirisfal Glades as corpses break free of the Scourge. Newly awakened Forsaken find him in a world they no longer recognize. He tests their sanity, tells them what they have become, and directs them toward service under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner.

Some bodies brought to the crypt never wake. Mordo soon casts them into the fire. Those who stir meet his dry impatience and little ceremony. If they have kept their wits, he sends them up the steps and down the road to Shadow Priest Sarvis at the chapel, where Sarvis explains their new existence. The mindless zombies overrunning the north of the village are Sarvis's concern. He sends the newly risen to destroy them.
